summary: @servicetitan/marketing-widgets preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Version 1.0.7 of @servicetitan/marketing-widgets ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts and chmods the Bun binary in a tempdir, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string-array plus `_0xXXXX` identifiers, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` so it will only execute under the freshly-dropped Bun runtime). The file is not listed in `package.json`'s `files` field (which declares only `dist` and `src`) but is shipped at the tarball root, and its opaque content cannot be reviewed. The package's declared purpose is a React marketing-widgets component library, which does not require a second language runtime or an out-of-tree opaque payload. The alternate-runtime loader is used to evade Node-based tooling and build isolation; the actual behavior of `math_init.js` executes with the installer's privileges at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
